subject: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@ekohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the quick intro. As discussed, attaching a draft mutual action plan (MPA_Workback.xlsx) and a short list of initial questions (EkoHealth_questions.docx) so we can align on procurement flow and acceptance criteria for a marketplace private-offer evaluation (AWS or GCP). High level asks from our side: 

- Confirm which marketplace you intend to close on (AWS Private Offer vs GCP MPA) and the billing entity to be used on invoices.
- Procurement contact, preferred PO cadence, and standard payment terms (Net30/45/etc.).
- Any required security evidence beyond SOC 2 (data residency, encryption controls, audit logs).

Proposed timeline (very flexible):
1) Week 0: MAP kickoff + procurement intake (this email)
2) Week 1–2: Technical eval (canary capacity) + acceptance checklist
3) Week 3: Procurement & PO routing; legal redlines if any
4) Week 4: Finalize private-offer & start staged acceptance

Can you confirm who on your side owns vendor onboarding and whether legal wants a template redline? I’d like to schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week (Mon–Wed window).

Thanks — I’ll coordinate internal owners once you confirm the attendees.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MPA_Workback.xlsx, EkoHealth_questions.docx
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@ekohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ekohealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@ekohealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan & the attachments. Quick answers: we expect to use AWS Private Offer but want an option to evaluate on GCP if performance differs during the technical check. Procurement lead is Rajiv Patel (cc’d). Legal will likely ask for SOC2 and our vendor questionnaire completed. I uploaded procurement guidance on our side — attaching their checklist for visibility (procurement_requirements.pdf).

We can do a kickoff on Tuesday 11/10 at 10:00am PT. That works for Rajiv?

Thanks,
Samantha
Head of Platform Integrations, EkoHealth
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)

Team —

Noted. A couple internal points before the kickoff: 
- We should present two invoice flows: (A) AWS Private Offer routed via customer’s billing org; (B) GCP MPA routed through partner/hybrid billing. Jordan, can you draft a one-page invoice example for each so Rajiv has clarity on tax entity / billing name?
- Ops: we can spin canary capacity for a 3-day technical eval; recommend 50k tokens/day test workload (sparse inference) as a first pass.
- Legal: prepare a minimal redline we can accept for private-offer terms to avoid procurement stalls. Neha — can you prep the SOC2 summary and the short security Q&A?

Action items: Jordan = invoice examples (by Mon EOD), Neha = SOC2 summary + Q&A doc (by Mon EOD). I’ll update the MAP after the kickoff with specific owners.

Karthik
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ekohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@ekohealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@ekohealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the plan. Procurement notes / timeline from our side: 
- Vendor onboarding form required (attached).
- Internal PO approval takes ~10 business days after we have final SOW and invoice examples.
- Need billing entity, W9 (US), and preferred payment terms (we default to Net30).
- For private offers we need a sample invoice showing how charges will appear on the AWS invoice.

We can target a PO issuance by 11/25 provided the SOW and invoice examples land this week. I attached our vendor onboarding form (vendor_onboarding_form.pdf) and my procurement checklist.

Rajiv
Head of Procurement, EkoHealth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@ekohealth.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ekohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 07:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)

Folks —

Following the kickoff and internal alignment, I’m sharing an updated mutual action plan and the items we’ll own. See attachments: MPA_Workback_v2.xlsx, Invoice_Spec-example.pdf, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf. Key milestones below (owners in parentheses):

- Week 0 (this week): Share invoice examples + SOC2 summary (Jordan, Neha) — due 11/11 EOD.
- Week 1 (11/12–11/18): Technical canary (Redwood infra) + acceptance test run (Samantha + Platform team). Acceptance criteria: latency targets within 20% of hosted baseline and pass 95% of eval prompts. (Karthik / Samantha)
- Week 2 (11/19–11/25): Procurement & PO routing — finalize SOW and issue PO by 11/25 (Rajiv). Redwood will provide billing entity, W9, and final SOW. (Marissa / Rajiv)
- Week 3 (12/01): Start staged production rollout once PO is live; monitor usage and billing cadence. (Marissa / EkoHealth Ops)

Open items:
- Payment terms: default Net30 accepted; confirm if Net45 required.
- Legal redlines: Neha will circulate a one-page term summary to minimize back-and-forth.
- Data residency: Redwood confirms no cross-region replication for the eval data unless requested.

Next meeting: Tuesday 11/10 10:00am PT — agenda: 15m technical plan, 10m procurement questions, 5m next steps.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MPA_Workback_v2.xlsx, Invoice_Spec-example.pdf, Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@ekohealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@ekohealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Marketplace MAP & Eval Plan for EkoHealth (private-offer billing path)

Marissa / team —

All looks good. Confirmed for the 11/10 kickoff (we’ll be prepared to start the canary the following day if Redwood can provision). Rajiv — Net30 is preferred; please flag if that changes.

Two asks from our side before the eval:
1) Can Redwood provide a short example of how usage lines will appear on the AWS invoice for the private offer? (Jordan already has action item)
2) Can we get a small reserved test capacity (canary) for the first 72 hours with traffic-shaping to emulate peak reads?

Thanks — Samantha
[End of thread]
